flaws.description: Replaced the x-axis label with a wrong quantity label 'Governance Quality Score (0-10)' instead of the true 'Governance Impact on Economic Performance (%)'.
Swapped the label strings in the two barh calls so that red bars are now labeled 'High Governance Impact' and teal bars 'Low Governance Impact'.
Changed the 11th element in Governance Impact (High) from 5.9 to 7.0 (5.9 * 1.6 ≈ 9.44, rounded to 1 decimal = 7.0).
